other_statuses.schedule only: no stop output for the period (schedule-based fields only)
other_statuses.no service: no scheduled trips of the route-direction in the period
other_statuses.not simulated: scheduled, but its stops could not be mapped onto the SUMO net
other_statuses.no simulated calls: simulated, but no scheduled call fell inside the evaluated window
other_statuses.model gap: more than unreached_share_gap of the scheduled calls were never reached in the model (buses teleported past simulated jams), so its delays are not reliable

thresholds.rule: class = worse of (mean arrival delay vs mean_delay_min) and (90th percentile delay vs p90_delay_min): below the first bound 'on time', below the second 'minor delay', below the third 'major delay', else 'severe'; 'model gap' instead when more than unreached_share_gap of the scheduled calls in the window were not reached. Delay = simulated arrival (stopinfo 'started') - scheduled arrival, over calls scheduled in [period start, period end - censor_margin_min] (warm-up and the last minutes, whose late buses would be cut off by the end of the run, excluded). Bunching = share of simulated headways at the busiest stop shorter than bunching_factor x the scheduled mean headway; regularity = coefficient of variation of those headways.

nature.stops_and_timetables: BODS GTFS: real NaPTAN stop locations and real *scheduled* timetables (not real-time, not observed running times)
nature.delays_speeds_status: SUMO model estimates, not observations; general traffic is whatever the period run used (DfT-calibrated by default, synthetic with --synthetic)
nature.unavailable: no real-time vehicle positions (AVL/SIRI-VM) or passenger loads were used
